page.about.frame.003.text:
MyInsta is an independent Android project with Ghost Mode viewing controls, supported downloads, and appearance settings. The available options can change by build.

The project is not affiliated with Instagram or Meta. Each release page lists its changes, compatibility details, known issues, and APK link. The link may open an external host such as DevUploads.

page.about.seodescription: Why MyInsta exists and how the independent project approaches product choices.
page.about.title: About MyInsta
page.faq.frame.003.text:
The most common questions are answered on the homepage from the published FAQ collection. Build requirements and known issues belong to the exact release record because they can change over time.

If the public documentation does not answer your question, contact support rather than relying on a third-party download page.

page.security.frame.002.text: A publish gate, not a trust badge.
page.security.frame.003.text:
Release APKs are uploaded directly to private object storage with an expected SHA-256 checksum. A background worker downloads the object, confirms its checksum and APK magic, and uses the Android apksigner tool to verify the signing certificate before publication.

Public downloads resolve through short-lived signed URLs. If you believe you found a vulnerability, email support with a concise impact description and reproduction steps. Do not include live credentials or unrelated personal data.
page.security.frame.005.label: Inspect release checksums
page.security.seodescription: How MyInsta verifies APKs, protects release storage, and handles vulnerability reports.
page.security.title: Security
page.support.frame.003.text:
For useful support, include the MyInsta version and build number, Android version, device architecture, and the exact error you saw. Do not send passwords, session cookies, private messages, or other sensitive account content.

For a download concern, compare the file with the SHA-256 listed on the release page when one is provided.

release.myinsta-v27.patchnotes: Typing, conversation Seen, Story/live and inspected view-once controls are all independent.
Seen after reply, Seen after reacting and an optional in-chat Mark as seen button are available. Removing a reaction cannot undo Seen, and failed reactions don’t send a receipt.
With Keep View-Once Media on, eligible media and its unopened indicator are preserved. With it off, eligible incoming media already in the native snapshot is marked as consumed.
Later incoming, outgoing, expired and already opened items stay outside the captured read boundary.
Upload audio in the native More menu lets you pick, preview and confirm a voice message. Received voice messages can be downloaded.
DM reaction emojis follow the selected emoji style without changing what is transmitted.
Optional local preservation of supported received messages after a confirmed unsend.
Includes inline copies, an account-isolated searchable archive, private notifications, attachment readers and confirmed conversation cleanup.
Content must already be available locally. Missing or expired media is not recovered.
Independent controls for normal Stories, Close Friends and highlights.
Organizer features: account order, viewed-state handling, Close Friends account selection, age filters, continuous playback and exact unseen counts.
Opening a Story stays immediate while pending Home pages load in the background. An account missing from a native response needs a later response.
Anonymous Story Viewing has separate options for manual Mark as seen and a receipt after a confirmed like, reaction or reply. Both are off by default.
Optional tappable @N mention indicators follow the visible header, including rotating time/music/filter text.
Alternate layouts: the Reels Stories bar (including Friends) supports organizer filters and Hide tray highlights, with the local Reels dark palette. The alternate highlight-cover menu is supported.
The experimental Stories summary keeps native behavior and only retains scoped colors.
Supported downloads cover posts, Reels, Stories, Direct media and received voice messages.
Video options: First frame, Audio only, Story Photo only, and carousel selection.
Optional, default-off Download comment media for photo/GIF comments, preserving animation with GIF, WebP or MP4 options when supplied.
The Prism four-action row now fits its first and last actions.
Downloads use the configured folder, queue, notifications and retry actions.
Opt-in controls under Privacy delay new post and Reel likes by 3, 5 or 10 seconds (default 5), with separate post and Reel switches and an optional Undo.
The heart and count update immediately. Unliking or Undo before dispatch cancels the request.
Leaving the app, switching accounts, closing the originating screen or disabling protection also cancels pending likes.
Existing double-tap blockers remain independent.
Independent app and chat fonts, with Inter, Roboto, Nunito, Lora and Caveat presets, plus text and color-emoji font import.
Downloadable Facebook, JoyPixels, Samsung and iOS emoji styles. They render locally only and don’t change the system keyboard or transmitted Unicode.
Native Story editor fonts and previewed creative Direct drafts.
Restart-required changes offer Restart now or Later.
Six independent, default-off Instants controls: new UI, photo zoom, swipe advance, downloads, gallery upload and screenshots.
Eight editable presets, Monet and AMOLED, five-color Story rings, live preview, undo/cancel, and theme import/export.
Separate Liquid Glass controls with independent material settings for Monet and Instagram default.
Navigation ordering, recommendation and button visibility controls.

Broad native coverage: profiles, inbox, search, notifications, settings, conversation details, Home/video controls, Explore, follower categories, Subscriptions, discovery lists and requests, News filters, Direct and rounded Reels menus.
The likes-list page, search field, names and labels follow the active palette and AMOLED, including recycled rows. Native Follow controls and avatars are preserved.
Reduced repeated theme work on Home. Direct conversations stay below the pinned inbox header, and Profile now precedes Customize in the details row.
Improved Reels playback-bar clearance, contextual Reel layout and inbox Instants spacing.
Controls for ads, analytics and video cache, plus gestures, selective recommendations and Discover people locations.
Save and Repost visibility is configurable for Feed, posts and Reels, including counters.
Disable analytics now also suppresses the inspected contacts and location onboarding prompts. Android permission requests and manual management screens are kept.
Better ad filtering in Home, Following and Favorites. Pull-to-refresh blocking now covers Explore.
Distraction Free controls remain separately configurable.
Floating profile-photo viewer on long press. Profile photos use the display name, and highlight covers use the highlight title.
Improved external link handoff on UnClone builds.
All ten main settings cards use a title, centered scene artwork and a description.
Export/Import for MOD settings, theme recipes and selections.
“Include developer flags” is unchecked by default.
Imports are validated and previewed, attempt rollback on failure, and offer Restart now or Later.
Accounts, archives, media, caches, font files and folder permissions are excluded.
Deprecated automatic-decryption controls are removed. The readable mapping and validated flag import/export remain.
Developer experiment files validate before import and merge by parameter, and exports use readable version/date filenames.
The Wiki gains a Developer Flags guide with evidence labels (code-verified, name-inferred, unresolved).
